definitions.explanation: Measures, materials, or activities intended to prevent fires or limit their spread. Commonly used in building codes, safety regulations, and community fire safety contexts.

examples.japanese: {防火|ぼうか}ドアを{閉|し}めてください。
この{地域|ちいき}は{防火|ぼうか}{対策|たいさく}が{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: Fire prevention measures are strict in this area.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}では{毎年|まいとし}{防火|ぼうか}{訓練|くんれん}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Fire prevention drills are held every year at school.

notes:
{防|ぼう} means 'to prevent' or 'to protect against,' and {火|か} means 'fire.' {防火|ぼうか} covers both preventing fires from starting and limiting their spread through fireproof materials and construction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防火|ぼうか}ドア (fire door)
- {防火|ぼうか}{訓練|くんれん} (fire prevention drill)
- {防火|ぼうか}{対策|たいさく} (fire prevention measures)
- {防火|ぼうか}{壁|へき} (firewall, fire barrier)
- {防火|ぼうか}{水槽|すいそう} (fire cistern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消火|しょうか} — fire extinguishing (putting out a fire that has already started)
- {耐火|たいか} — fire resistance (ability of a material to withstand fire)
- {防災|ぼうさい} — disaster prevention (broader, covers earthquakes, floods, etc.)
